mechanism: Sacubitril inhibits neprilysin, reducing dronedarone metabolism and increasing exposure; both agents have negative inotropic and hypotensive effects; dronedarone is a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor which may increase sacubitril levels.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and cardiac function closely; consider dose adjustments of dronedarone; ensure adequate renal function monitoring and assess for bradycardia and hypotension.
